title: Parent Communication App for Schools
seoTitle: Parent Communication App for Indian Schools
seoDescription: A parent communication app or WhatsApp service for schools: attendance alerts, homework, circulars, fee reminders, report cards and two-way messages.
summary: A parent communication system gives schools one reliable channel for attendance alerts, homework, circulars, fee reminders and report cards, instead of dozens of unmanaged WhatsApp groups. It can be a school app, a WhatsApp Business service, or both, and it keeps a record of what was sent to whom.

body:
## Why move off personal WhatsApp groups

- Teachers' personal numbers are exposed.
- Messages get lost in chatter.
- There is no record of what was communicated.
- Parent data sits on personal phones, a concern under the [DPDP Act](/glossary/dpdp-act).

## App or WhatsApp

Most parents already use WhatsApp, so an official WhatsApp service reaches everyone without an install. A school app adds richer features such as report cards and galleries. See [custom app vs WhatsApp bot](/compare/custom-app-vs-whatsapp-bot).

Want to see what this would look like for your business? [Book a 30-minute scoping call](/book-consultation).
